custody_facts.reason: The inherited-descriptor inventory excludes target channels; W must receive with no ancillary buffer and discard unexpected rights. RESOLVE_UNIX denial blocks new external-domain pathname-server connections; MAKE_SOCK only beneath private binds prevents externally reachable new socket files; private network namespace blocks incoming abstract sockets. The exact constructed root/mount view, all exec/fork inheritance and no inherited ring/binder channel must be established. Installed header semantics support the mechanisms, not their implementation.

Distinct host R/GATE and root-owned user namespace block ordinary outside ptrace-checked routes under the named credential/capability premise. Helpers independently set non-dumpability after each exec; inherited bootstrap must be covered and own-scope actor state must stay exact. P-PTRACE requires operation- and object-specific positive controls. The alternative same-host-uid root-owned user namespace also matters because commoncap is namespace-sensitive, contrary to c8.

Protected g ancestry, genuinely private mount propagation and no ptrace-based proc-root access can exclude externally usable names; cross-vfsmount link/rename refusal excludes an additional link out of a source bind. Same st_dev is correctly discarded as proof. File-handle behavior needs exact installed-version capability/idmap/ancestor reasoning. The assertion EXDEV occurs before any permission check is false and not needed for the no-success predicate. A leaked string is not automatically a usable inode name; define precisely the reference/name property being enforced.

cgroup.events populated reports live tasks in a subtree. With root-only entry/migration and lease exclusion, a correctly emptied old scope can stay empty; joining stable predicates is better than the old moving process/descriptor scan. The no-entry premise must cover every earlier target/observer scope and every fork/credential/exec route. A populated-zero observation is not in itself all-description release, no deferred kernel work, no registered-ring/AIO write or persisted durability. P-IOEXIT needs an exact logical-mutation statement and installed source argument across every I/O/deferred release path. Kernel normal exit orders exit_files/exit_fs before cgroup_task_exit, but that limited ordering does not prove all asynchronous holders/drain effects. P-CENSUS instantaneous ActiveState/populated equivalence is false as an event-driven-manager general invariant; do not weaken the original release predicate to make it fit.

Step 11 clones/attaches the root mount and reconstructs selected mounts, then step 12 checks mountinfo. No step explicitly adopts the new root and cwd for the process filesystem context, closes all old-root paths/descriptions, or explains why ordinary absolute and relative path lookup use the new idmapped tree. In the inspected Linux source absolute lookup starts from current->fs->root and relative lookup from current->fs->pwd; do_move_mount attaches a tree and supplies no corresponding fs_struct rebase. A mount table alone therefore cannot establish the intended identity, masking, omitted-mount or O_NOATIME-owner properties. Supply a precise non-writing construction with root/cwd/path-descriptor readback and preserving error analysis; do not assume the missing step or execute a probe during this review.
custody_facts.source_boundary: Static inference from upstream v7.2; exact installed-kernel matching and launcher implementation remain future evidence.

custody_facts.reason: There is no P_out/copy/attribute replay/root exchange. M8 finishes recipe/materialization and generation journal; later records/export packs are in g_rec and no frame helper writes source/output/tmp contents. C10 immediately repeats exact recipe/leaf metadata and parent-observation equality before spawn. ACL statements now apply to recipe/bookkeeping/export objects while target modes/default ACLs remain target behavior; adopt seal timing is explicit. This is a genuine repair of the former mutation-order contradiction, conditional on actual no-atime reads and a correctly implemented view, not complete custody proof.

privileged_effect_assessment: N5 enumerates transient scope and namespace settings but claims no file write on a host filesystem. Step 10 explicitly writes /proc/<pid>/uid_map, gid_map and setgroups; system-manager scope creation entails control-plane effects. Audit/sudo/systemd records and any persistent helper output need the same causal inventory as direct writes. Establish which effects already lie in documented original outside-tree authority; otherwise keep V5-B02 OPEN and redesign. No new exemption is created merely because a filesystem is pseudo, a mask is tmpfs, or a daemon performs the effect.

read_routes.assessment: Explicit W/W2 O_NOATIME on owned T records/recipe/snapshot, including directories, prevents the stated read-atime route when implemented and ownership/flags hold. No execution was performed.

C/O directory, excluded-leaf and proof-report reads explicitly use O_NOATIME and ownership through U_run. This repairs the omitted proof-report route locally. Prove every entry read has that ownership and every actual helper open uses the flag, including error paths; report bytes must be read through the promised held source view.

Direct reads of sicarii-owned lead inputs can use O_NOATIME without dropping foreign-owner accepted inputs. However F remains non-isolated, and its site/.pth/import ctypes/dynamic-loader reads happen before main; ordinary importer/helper reads are not made O_NOATIME just by requiring the flag in frame methods. An owner-based row is not exhaustive by itself.

Foreign-owned readable original inputs may cause atime outside T. The original readers pin no owner; refusing these inputs or giving broad CAP_FOWNER would change the domain/authority. The fallback read honestly preserves the case while leaving V5-B02 OPEN. No exception granted.

Mapped sicarii-owned tool/data/vendor files can be read by C/O with O_NOATIME only if actual process root and mount paths use the planned idmaps. Header/map text and a first run do not prove all original observation equality or all reads.

Interpreter/stdlib/installed-frame/etc/usr and root-owned images-directory listings can produce read-atime outside T; root-controlled location does not satisfy an inside-T mutation requirement. Keeping this OPEN is correct. Moving it into a permitted residual or forcing noatime host/view policy is not granted.

Pseudo-filesystem is not synonymous with no observable filesystem/control-plane effect. The read row must establish the actual metadata behavior, and it cannot cover explicit writes to uid_map/gid_map/setgroups, cgroup state or daemon-generated records. Persistence is not the criterion used for the frame-owned mutation guarantee.

C executable/library loading touches sicarii-owned toolchain files outside T without an O_NOATIME exec interface. The proposal correctly leaves it OPEN. This reviewer does not reclassify frame launch/loader effects as the running-target residual or grant an exception.

Inventory actual interpreter/importer, subprocess helpers, source identity/module hashing and their directory/error-path reads. Include foreign non-root owned runtime files as well as root-owned files, and read-side mutation of any helper-opened evidence. An automatic O_NOATIME assumption would be circular; retain the original accepted environment and N08 bootstrap ceiling while solving the added read-mutation obligation.

target_view_assessment: The view improves the in-place design but does not establish V5-B01/V5-B02 under a complete, sound set of stated premises. Conditional push/pull/name barriers are plausible; the actual root/cwd adoption is underspecified, the child lacks its mount-identity record, P-LL/P-XDEV/P-CENSUS overstate kernel facts, and cgroup emptiness does not itself establish all-holder/async logical-write quiescence. Source/output copying, chmod and root exchange are removed; the admitted-partition mutation ordering repair is closed locally. R-d/R-f/R-h correctly remain OPEN, with additional implicit-read/control-plane effect coverage required. No target-exec or pseudo-filesystem exception is granted.
